status: DRAFT — NOT LOCKED until author sign-off (see docs/reference/answerer_schema.md)
purpose: Single source of truth imported by the judge prompt, the cache format, and the fold interface. Every downstream experiment consumes exactly (channel, entity, value, knowledge/vividness). Locked thesis-wide once signed.

knowledge.description: Does the user know the entity well enough to have an opinion? (Decision D3 vividness hedge, renamed to knowledge for the 3-level form.) Observable hedging like a real human.

semantics.no_clue: Never heard of it / cannot answer. value is ABSENT.
semantics.rough_idea: Knows of it / barely remembers / 'I think I liked it?'. value present but down-weighted.
semantics.know_well: Seen it / remembers well / confident opinion. value present, full weight.

knowledge.can_answer_rule: can_answer == (knowledge != 'no_clue'). The design's can_answer{yes/no} is derived, not stored separately.

value.description: The graded sentiment the user would give. Present iff knowledge != 'no_clue'.

fold_confidence_weight.description: Weight applied to the centered fold value, as a function of knowledge. KNOB, not a constant — to be fit later (masked-value validation). Defaults below.
fold_confidence_weight.note: w_rough is the down-weight for rough_idea answers; documented as a fit parameter, not a fixed truth.

rating_to_scale.description: Maps a real ML-25M star rating (0.5..5.0) to the 4-level value scale. Used for rated cells (canonical answer = real rating). Fixed, documented.
rating_to_scale.note: A real rating implies the user saw the film => knowledge = know_well for rated cells.

channels.description: The five question channels. Each cell is keyed (channel, entity_id).

concept.value_source_primary: data-side member aggregate where >=k rated members
concept.value_source_fallback: LLM graded answer where <k rated members (flagged)

attribute.value_source_primary: data-side aggregate of user's ratings over the entity's member films

pair.value_source: which rated higher — real where both rated, LLM-compared otherwise (dual-answerer)

recall.rule: each framing usable ONCE per interview; v1 = Paper-D popularity-tilted sampler; LLM recall model = v1.1

dual_arena.description: Decision E pre-registered robustness rule. Every headline runs under two answerers.

arena_F.name: Arena-F (full)
arena_F.answers: real rating where rated; LLM graded answer where answerable-but-unrated

arena_R.name: Arena-R (rated-only)
arena_R.answers: only cells with a real rating; answerable-but-unrated => treated as not answered

dual_arena.claim_rule: Claims stated where both arenas agree; disagreements reported as scope, not hidden.

fidelity.note: LLM masked-item validation MAE ~= 0.70 stars ~= human test-retest inconsistency (Amatriain). This is the fidelity sigma for the LLM-valued channel; re-anchored per V3.

fold_interface_contract.note: Raw LLM confidence floats are kept for analysis but NOT exposed to the agent/fold.
